content: Supabase Storage (S3-compatible, RLS-integrated, built-in image transforms/CDN) is the right default for UGC photo uploads when already on Supabase -- free 1GB then ~--.021/GB stored + --.09/GB egress, bundled into the /mo Pro plan quota. Cloudinary is stronger for heavy media transforms but starts at /mo, overkill for v1 budget.
